blocks.text: Llama 4 Maverick is a open-source language model from Meta, released on Apr 5, 2025.
At $0.15 input and $0.6 output per million tokens, it ranks #6 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 1M tokens ranks #27 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets vision, reasoning, budget workloads.
Throughput is measured at 118 tokens per second (ranked #9 of 23 for throughput).
Flagship of the Llama 4 herd; stronger reasoning and vision grounding than Scout.
